-- Tomás and the Library Lady
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Tomás and the Library Lady' AND t.name IN ('Theatre for Young Audiences', '2022', 'Latinx Theatre', 'Family Show', 'Educational', 'Bilingual')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
